groups.description: bread as food: Food made by cooking a dough of flour and liquid, usually by baking.
sourdough bread: Bread made from dough fermented with a culture of wild yeast and bacteria.
the human carnivore diet: A way of eating in which a person eats animal foods and avoids plant foods.
dogs as animals: Domesticated canine animals commonly kept as pets or used for work.
greeting people in the morning: An expression of welcome or goodwill addressed to someone during the morning.
wishing people a good morning: A greeting that expresses a wish for someone to have a pleasant morning.
coffee and coffee shops: A drink prepared from roasted coffee beans, and establishments where that drink is prepared and served.
music: Sounds arranged through rhythm, melody or harmony for expression or enjoyment.
